steps.en: The owner fills in hirer or driver details for chosen notices
steps.id: Owner mengisi data hirer atau driver untuk notice yang dipilih

steps.en: Supporting documents are uploaded and required ones are checked
steps.id: Dokumen bukti di-upload dan dokumen wajib dicek

steps.en: The submission is checked before it is accepted
The submission is saved as pending with a reference number
steps.id: Pengajuan disimpan sebagai pending dengan nomor referensi

steps.en: Submissions and documents are pulled into the internal system automatically
steps.id: Pengajuan dan dokumen ditarik ke sistem internal secara otomatis

steps.en: Submissions that pass every check are approved automatically
steps.id: Pengajuan yang lolos semua pengecekan disetujui otomatis

steps.en: Submissions that fail a check wait on the officer's list
steps.id: Pengajuan yang gagal cek menunggu di daftar officer

steps.en: The officer can approve or reject each pending submission
steps.id: Officer bisa menyetujui atau menolak tiap pengajuan pending
